title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint: Shortness of breath

HPI: 75 y.o. female pt presents for f/u of COPD. Pt reports stable symptoms over the past month. Denies increased cough, sputum production, or acute exacerbation. Reports mild exertional dyspnea but denies any fevers or chills. Pt states she is adhering to current medications.

Medication List:
- Tiotropium 18 mcg inhaled
- Salmeterol/Fluticasone 250/50 mcg inhaled
- Albuterol HFA 2mg PRN

Exam:
Gen: Alert, pleasant, in no acute distress.
Resp: CTAB. Breath sounds clear bilaterally. No wheezing or rhonchi.
CV: RRR, regular rhythm. No murmurs.
Ext: No edema.

Assessment:
1. COPD: Pt is currently stable. Symptoms reviewed and well-controlled on current regimen.

Plan:
1. COPD: Continue current medications. Pt to f/u in 3 months. Advised to seek immediate care for worsening dyspnea or increased sputum.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: The provider addressed COPD at this visit (status and plan documented), so it is supported and coded.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.

hccs.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease/Interstitial Lung Disorders/and Other Chronic Lung Disorders
